# TheBhom.in (Full Documentation)

> TheBhom.in is a premier Indian platform for curated online shopping deals, flash sale price-drop tracking, and web-based multimedia downloading utilities.

## Architecture & Overview

TheBhom is built for high speed, zero latency, and privacy-first web performance. All client tools operate in-browser without server upload requirements for personal files. The platform is organized into three core divisions:

1. **TheBhom Deals Store (`/deals/`)**: Handpicked, verified discount deals and price drops from Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and top Indian shopping destinations. Includes category filtering for Electronics, Fashion, Home, and Lightning Deals.
2. **Universal Video Downloader (`/downloader/`)**: High-speed, 1080p Full HD video downloader and audio extractor. Supports downloading from Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Facebook, and Twitter/X with zero watermarks.
3. **Editorial Knowledge Hub (`/articles/`)**: High-quality evergreen guides on technology, SEO, accessibility, and digital creator workflows.
